LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 1.3.1 WORD CLASSES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes, part of Strand 1 in Grade 6 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: How do we express the quantity or amount of something? 2. Why should we give the exact amount of something?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify the determiners some, enough, each and a lot of in sentences,

2. complete online quizzes and exercises involving the use of some, enough, each, and a lot of,

3. construct sentences using determiners,

4. make sentences using determiners from substitution tables,

5. correct the sentences constructed by a peer,

6. work in groups and determine the correctness of a sample of sentences. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify the determiners some, enough, each and a lot of in sentences,
2. complete online quizzes and exercises involving the use of some, enough, each, and a lot of,
3. construct sentences using determiners,
4. make sentences using determiners from substitution tables,
5. correct the sentences constructed by a peer,
6. work in groups and determine the correctness of a sample of sentences. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: The learner contributes to group decision making when identifying sentences

featuring determiners from a print or digital text.

• Digital Literacy: The learner interacts with technology when completing online quizzes and exercises involving

the use of determiners.

Values:
Social justice: The learner fosters fairness by reviewing the sentences constructed by a peer.

Responsibility: The learner engages in assigned roles as they construct sentences using determiners.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Peace Education: The learner nurtures social cohesion as they work in groups to determine the correctness of a sample

of sentences.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of determiners when editing their written work in Kiswahili.
